observed_facts: Hon Hai (2317) subsidiary Lin Yin International Investment board-approved agreement on 2026-10-16 to acquire 503 Mitsubishi Electric Mobility common shares, representing 50%, for consideration not exceeding JPY115bn.
Reported full target enterprise value JPY320bn, equity value JPY230bn; 50% of equity value is JPY115bn; deal subject to closing financial-statement adjustment.
Transaction subject to antitrust and other regulatory approvals; anticipated closing 2027-10-01 per attributed company statement. Not completed acquisition or realized revenue.
April 24, 2026 MoU previously existed; this is a later definitive equity-acquisition agreement with newly disclosed price and closing date, not a new customer order.
